sources.title: TheoremSearch API Docs
locators: API Docs lines 6-34: fixed base URL and POST /search request fields
API Docs lines 45-69: response example includes body, slogan, similarity, score and paper metadata
supports: The fixed endpoint and {query,n_results} request match the official API.
The documented response supplies ranking fields similarity and score in addition to result order.

sources.title: TheoremSearch Privacy Policy
locators: Privacy Policy lines 5-12: provider logs search query text and filters
Privacy Policy lines 13-15: stated use of query logs
supports: A user-facing disclosure can accurately say that TheoremSearch logs the submitted query text under its current policy.

limitations: The provider pages are mutable web sources; local response bytes and hashes pin what was read.
This source check does not validate provider implementation, corpus quality, ranking quality or mathematical correctness.
